Operations Management: Manage the distribution center's sorting, scanning, route planning, load optimization, and incoming and outgoing shipments.

Team Handling: Manage shift rosters and keep track of attendance while supervising delivery executives, field workers, and vendor labor.

Performance tracking: Keep an eye on key performance indicators (KPIs) such return\-to\-origin (RTO) metrics, turnaround time (TAT), and delivery success rates.

Problem Solving: Manage non\-delivery reports (NDR), address operational escalations, and address delivery delays at the field level.
